_comment: Policy for the launcher's own Chromium instance. The launcher renders our local touch UI over loopback and must never be able to reach the internet — if it can, the origin pinning on the session browser is pointless because a child could just use the launcher's browser.
_captive_portal_note: Captive-portal escape needs a temporary, restricted browser session with a different policy. That is a separate short-lived instance, NOT this one, and it returns to the launcher when the portal completes. Do not widen this allowlist to solve captive portals.
